card.title: LONDON
card.text: The capital of the British Empire and the center of the British and Allied war effort in Europe.
card.flavorText: London, the capital city of the UK, was hit hard by German bombing in the so called “Blitz” that lasted from September 1940 to May 1941, and from 1944 to 1945 the V1 bomb and V2 rocket attacks caused massive casualties and damage. During the war London was also the home of several governments in exile and hosted large numbers of overseas personnel, which put it at the center of the Allied war effort in Europe.
